mapping_rules: SignalLab AudioMap validates decoded-frame sample total against serialized native PCM samples; missing/invalid source times remain null.
PTS discontinuities create separate timeline segments; windows crossing boundaries carry an explicit flag and pitch abstains.
SignalLab pitch starts map independently rounded absolute native sample positions to the 16kHz derivative. Noninteger hops must not accumulate rounding drift.
AudioAtlas original integer-floor hop behavior is preserved. The product only selects 16kHz or48kHz profiles where10ms is integral.
SignalLab review reports center-selected word joins. Sales Xray uses conservative full-window containment, and does not call them equivalent.
No SignalLab output or model review is proof of calibrated acoustic accuracy. Engine-specific spectral scaling, FFT lengths and windows remain distinct.
A source track origin alone cannot certify codec delay, resampling latency, discontinuities or container/video synchronization. No constant offset is fabricated.
